stem.text: A micrometer screw gauge is used to measure the diameter of a copper wire.
The reading with the wire in position is shown in diagram 1. The wire is removed and the jaws of the micrometer are closed. The new reading is shown in diagram 2.

stem.alt: Micrometer screw gauge with sleeve scale marked 0 and thimble scale marked 5, 10 and 15.
stem.label: diagram 1

stem.alt: Micrometer screw gauge with jaws closed, sleeve scale marked 0 and thimble scale marked 10, 15 and 20.
stem.label: diagram 2

stem.text: What is the diameter of the wire?
